description: FREE check of a DEPLOYED contract by address (chain: base, ethereum, bnb, arbitrum, optimism or polygon; default base), no key and no wallet. Kestrova fetches the contract's verified source (Sourcify), follows proxies to the current implementation and returns the same free preview as scan_solidity_preview (severity counts, High/Medium detector names, one example finding) plus contract facts (name, compiler, proxy). Unverified contracts get bytecode signals instead (likely owner powers such as mint, pause, blacklist, fee changes, upgradeability). Use before your agent interacts with, buys or approves a contract. Automated pattern detection, not an audit: it does not detect honeypots or rug pulls, and zero findings does not mean safe.
name: scan_contract_address_preview
